title: Rezoning to allow housing at 69-67 108th Street, Queens
summary: This application would change the zoning map at 69-67 108th Street in Forest Hills, Queens from an R1-2A district to an R7D district with a C2-4 commercial overlay. The change would help enable an 11-story mixed-use building with about 59 apartments, including 15 income-restricted units, plus 3,900 square feet of commercial space. It is related to a separate zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for the site.
